Browse D-PLACE dataset contributions (sources)

Source: R/dp_contributions.R
dp_contributions.Rd

Browse D-PLACE dataset contributions (sources)

Usage

dp_contributions(contribution_id = NULL, type = NULL)

Arguments

contribution_id

Optional character vector of contribution IDs to filter to.

type

Optional character vector restricting to contribution type(s), e.g. `"dataset"` or `"phylogeny"`.

Value

A tibble of contributions (see [dplace_contributions] for column definitions).

Examples

dp_contributions(type = "dataset")
#> # A tibble: 14 × 7
#>    contribution_id           name   description contributor citation doi   type
